scope: Every vector is a message sequence the package's parseServerMessage accepts, one message at a time. The set keeps to guuey's id charset, its §6 bounds, and reference-complete trees: an id outside the charset, an over-bound value or a dangling child are guuey's deliberate refusals or degrades, pinned in validate.test.ts and fold.test.ts, not conformance vectors.

components.text: Build a sign up form for the beta
build a sign up form for the beta.

vectors.name: updateComponents with no createSurface first (an orphan: accepted, drawn nowhere)
unknown extra fields on the message, the payload and each component (stripped)
an id replaced by a later batch (the replace key)
empty strings where preview allows them (Text text, Button label, labels)
an Image src preview takes and policy A refuses: still an Image (its chip)
an off-policy https Image: still an Image (a link with its host)
an unknown Icon name: still an Icon (the host draws nothing)
ids that are valid in both (charset letters, digits, _ . : -)
